# Rating study: expected interval half-widths

Simulated from the a4-v1 export of 2026-11-12T20:31:18+00:00, all raters, unweighted: humans say "same" on 74% of the judge's "same" pairs and 18% of its "different" pairs; 34% of the current set is judge-"same". Every half-width is multiplied by 1.199 for pairs sharing a task. 4000 simulated studies per cell.

Check against the real data: measured kappa 0.538, measured half-width 0.186 (114 labelled ratings on 109 pairs).

Half-width of the 95% interval. "Split" is the share of pairs on which two raters disagree - not yet measurable, so three cases are shown.
